themeCards.title: Jobless claims fell to 196,000 as the 10-year yield eased to 4.94%
themeCards.fact: Los Angeles Times AP: initial jobless claims fell to 196,000, the fewest since mid-July and down from 206,000, a miss versus the 207,500 FactSet estimate. 财经早茶 今日图表: 美国上周首次申领失业救济人数降至历史低位, with continuing claims through 5 September the lowest since 2024. US Treasury: the official 17 September 10-year yield was 4.94%.
themeCards.mechanism: A 196,000 claims print next to a 4.94% 10-year is the bond market treating rare layoffs as room for the post-hike bounce, not as a reason to retire another step. Morgan Stanley (17 September): the house added a March 2027 hike on top of December, which is why a labor miss still leaves a second move on the table. US industrial production at 21:15 Beijing is the next print.

themeCards.title: Brent settled at 104.82 as the S&P 500 posted its best day in six weeks
themeCards.fact: WTOP AP: the S&P 500 rose 85.95 points to 7,637.76. TV News Check AP: Brent crude settled at 104.82. 财经早茶 能源: 原油期货下跌，交易员押注中东石油供应紧张局面不会持久.
themeCards.mechanism: A 104.82 Brent settle with a 7,637.76 S&P close is cash pricing some of the Middle East tightness back out, which is the same oil-to-inflation channel the 财经早茶 美国股市 line named. Lagarde at 18:30 Beijing is the next inflation-policy print that still carries that energy tape.

themeCards.title: Japan’s August core CPI missed at 1.7% into the BOJ decision
themeCards.fact: CNBC: Japan’s August headline CPI held at 1.9%, and core inflation excluding fresh food eased to 1.7%, a miss versus the 1.8% Reuters estimate. 财经早茶 国际要闻: 日本央行周五将公布利率决定，普遍预计该行将进行三个月内第二次加息.
themeCards.mechanism: A 1.7% core miss still sits next to a 1.9% headline that keeps the BOJ’s second-hike case alive into this afternoon rather than retiring it. The BOJ policy statement on 18 September is the settle.

themeCards.title: The BOE held at 3.75% and halted long-dated gilt sales
themeCards.fact: Bank of England: the MPC voted 6-3 to maintain Bank Rate at 3.75%, and voted to reduce gilt holdings for monetary policy to zero through annual sales of 20 billion pounds alongside maturities. 财经早茶 欧洲股债: 英国国债上涨，因英国央行宣布调整量化紧缩安排.
themeCards.mechanism: Holding at 3.75% while rewriting gilt sales takes duration supply off the tape even as the Bank warns energy could still force a later hike. UK August retail sales at 14:00 Beijing are the next print.

themeCards.title: Shanghai closed at 3875.60 as youth unemployment rose to 18.9%
themeCards.fact: 证券时报: Shanghai closed at 3875.60 on 17 September, down 0.41%. 钛媒体: August urban 16–24 unemployment excluding students was 18.9%. 财经早茶 大中华: 据悉美国拟加征的对华关税至少等到下周习近平访美结束后才会宣布.
themeCards.mechanism: A 3875.60 close next to an 18.9% youth rate is the A-share book trading domestic activity and the Xi visit rather than the 16 September funds-rate spillover. CICC (17 September): this Fed hike does not equal the start of a US hiking cycle for A-shares, which is why the housing briefing still sets the next tape. The State Council Information Office housing briefing at 10:00 Beijing is the next print.

themeCards.title: Bitcoin held 76,621 after a 295.98 million ETF outflow
themeCards.fact: CoinDesk: bitcoin was at 76,621, up 0.88% over 24 hours. CoinDesk: US spot bitcoin ETFs shed 295.98 million dollars on Wednesday.
themeCards.mechanism: A 76,621 handle that rose with Nasdaq still sits on a 295.98 million Wednesday ETF outflow, so the bounce is risk-asset beta rather than new structural bids. Glassnode (16 September): bitcoin has slipped back under the True Market Mean and ETF, stablecoin and corporate demand has stalled. The Conference Board leading index at 22:00 Beijing is the next risk-asset print.
